Name: Better Fruit Bat Cave
Author: po0pfart
Description:
Whether it's for bundle, NPC gifts, replenish stamina or small starting income, it's just not enough as farm cave fruit option has a very low spawn rate. This mod lets you do the following:

[list]
[*]Whether mushroom option cave can spawn fruit on the same fashion as bat fruit type,
[*]The chance farm cave spawns another fruit after previous spawn,
[*]Control each fruit spawn chance and maximum spawn number
[/list]Also adds content from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Configs will only show up for what additional mod is installed to avoid confusion.

Keep in mind vanilla farm cave has a very limited space to spawn, even lesser if you put more objects. I suggest download bigger farm cave mod.

Check out my other QoL mods too!
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/po0pfart/mods]po0pfart's Mods[/url]
